reasoning: On the season so far the Cavaliers are the stronger team; with home court the Cavaliers start about 2 points better, in a game of about 238 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Cavaliers.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Cavaliers win 56 times in 100, by about 2; most games like this end between 211 and 259 total points.
